scope: Read-only repository reconnaissance, primary-source research and synthetic local calculations. No repository candidate was validated.

sources.title: The Incomplete Rosetta Stone Problem: Identifiability Results for Multi-View Nonlinear ICA
sources.authors: Gresele, Rubenstein, Mehrjou, Locatello and Scholkopf
sources.type: Primary conference paper, UAI 2019 proceedings published 2020
sources.classification: established mathematical result conditional on stated model
sources.inspected: Sections 3.1-3.3, Definition 2, Theorems 1, 5 and 8, equations 17-21, discussion
sources.use: Scope of multi-view identifiability and the distinction between demixing and noiseless recovery.
sources.limit: Asymptotic result with restrictive generative and diversity assumptions. Theorem 8 includes residual restrictions beyond observed independence.

sources.title: Incomplete Rosetta Stone supplementary material
sources.classification: established mathematical result conditional on stated model
sources.use: Deterministic-view issue, diversity-condition counterexample and permutation ambiguity.
sources.limit: The Gaussian diversity failure is relevant to the multicomponent case. It does not imply known linear Gaussian measurement models cannot benefit from additional observations.

sources.title: Removing systematic errors for exoplanet search via latent causes
sources.authors: Scholkopf, Hogg, Wang, Foreman-Mackey, Janzing, Simon-Gabriel and Peters
sources.classification: established mathematical result conditional on stated causal model
sources.inspected: Section 2, Figure 1, Proposition 1, equations 1-9 and incomplete-information discussion
sources.use: A reference may help estimate a target by measuring shared nuisance rather than the target signal.
sources.limit: The assumed structure is not inferred by the method. Signal leakage into a control can remove real variation.

sources.title: ASASSN-24fw: Candidate gas-rich circumsecondary disk occultation of a main-sequence star
sources.version: arXiv:2507.05367v3, 12 November 2025; HTML title differs from stale abstract-page title
sources.classification: published observational result with conditional physical interpretation
sources.inspected: Section III.1, figures 5-6, paragraphs on period alternatives; section IV.5 alternatives
sources.use: DASCH historical dimmings plus ASAS normal-brightness coverage distinguish period aliases.
sources.limit: Period determination does not uniquely identify the occulter's physical nature. This is prior work, not a Foundation0 discovery.

sources.title: The Rise and Fall of the Eclipsing Binary HS Hydrae
sources.authors: Davenport, Windemuth, Warmbein, Howard, Klein and Birky
sources.classification: published observational result with dynamical interpretation
sources.inspected: Abstract, sections 2-4, final paragraph before acknowledgments describing TESS Sector 35
sources.use: A century-scale archive join traces eclipse appearance changing while the binary persists.
sources.limit: The predicted long-term return of eclipses is a model forecast. It was not observed or reverified in this expedition.

sources.title: DASCH DR7 Lightcurve Reduction Guide
sources.inspected: Introduction, Source Splitting, AFLAG rejections and Plate Series sections
sources.use: Existing reduction requirements, blends and time-clustered instrument-series artifacts.
sources.limit: The guide explicitly describes itself as under development. It does not certify any candidate.

sources.title: DASCH DR7 Photometric Calibration ASDF File Contents
sources.use: Reference-star, local-correction and quality information for a proposed calibration audit.
sources.limit: No actual calibration metadata files were retrieved in this pass.

sources.title: Accelerating Atomic Fine Structure Determination with Graph Reinforcement Learning
sources.authors: Ding, Darvariu, Ryabtsev, Hawes and Pickering
sources.classification: proposed computational method with retrospective evaluation
sources.use: Level-difference graph, multi-line matching and accidental-candidate dependence on line density.
sources.limit: The proposed held-out-line benchmark in this expedition has not been run. No new atomic level is claimed.

sources.title: Climate-Induced Decadal Ocean Wave Height Variability From Microseisms: 1931-2021
sources.classification: published empirical reconstruction under calibration assumptions
sources.inspected: Section 2 including archived seismograms and response adjustment, appendix A description
sources.use: Historical seismic records joined to modern buoy and instrument information.
sources.limit: Regional transfer model and sampling limitations. No new historical trend was estimated here.

sources.title: Ocean wave sources of seismic noise
sources.classification: physical source model with empirical comparison
sources.inspected: Indexed abstract and source-class discussion excerpt
sources.use: Different source contributions can limit microseism amplitude as a storm-climate proxy.
sources.limit: Full model implementation was not reproduced.

sources.title: An Evaluation of the Performance of the Twentieth Century Reanalysis Version 3
sources.type: Primary evaluation paper hosted by NOAA
sources.inspected: Abstract and description of assimilated observations
sources.use: Pressure assimilation makes observation provenance necessary when claiming an independent reanalysis comparison.
sources.limit: No station-level ISPD membership was checked in this pass. The independence warning is our inference from the assimilation design.

sources.title: Extracting distribution parameters from multiple uncertain observations with selection biases
sources.inspected: Introduction, problem statement and the derivation structure in sections 2-4
sources.use: Selection enters the normalization for population inference, not merely a weight on reported events.
sources.limit: Does not supply a selection function for the repository's rejected TESS candidates.

sources.title: Probabilistic Cross-Identification of Astronomical Sources
sources.use: A join between catalogues is itself an uncertain inference.

sources.title: Cross-Identification of Stars with Unknown Proper Motions
sources.authors: Kerekes, Budavari, Csabai, Connolly and Szalay
sources.use: Motion between epochs affects source associations.
sources.limit: Used for this narrow methodological statement only.

sources.title: ASASSN-21co: A detached eclipsing binary with an 11.9 year period
sources.classification: published observational result and conditional binary model
sources.use: Distinguishes the prior published modern-data interpretation from Foundation0's later archival claims.
sources.limit: Does not independently confirm the repository's 1902/1985 plate claims or refined prediction.

repository_sources.classification: repository claims and project policy, not independent observational confirmation
project leads, not evidence that the proposed archive searches are novel or successful

own_results.classification: synthetic analytical calculation and seeded simulation
own_results.claim: The specified nuisance control reduces posterior variance by 25.7519-fold; exact copies add no information; common-bias readouts do not remove the ambiguity.
own_results.limit: Known Gaussian measurement equations and priors. No nonlinear ICA training and no observational fit.

own_results.claim: An exposure where alternatives disagree adds information conditional on detection completeness.
own_results.limit: Invented times, discrete uniform prior, fixed eclipse, perfect event timing and no false alarms.

own_results.claim: Difference-cycle closure detects the constructed inconsistent line but survives a common multiplicative calibration error.
own_results.limit: Four-level arithmetic example, not an identified atom or complete transition model.

own_results.claim: Exposure ranking, one-candidate control audit, HS Hya benchmark, withheld-line recovery and short seismic calibration experiment.
own_results.limit: No empirical performance, novelty or discovery claim. Existing literature must be rechecked before project expansion.

retrieval_notes: ESA Gaia release page returned HTTP 451. Its planned date was not used as a scientific premise or repeated in the report.
Historical PDF-only arXiv sources were read through PDFs after guessed HTML versions returned 404.
No raw plates, TESS light curves, seismic waveforms or atomic spectra were acquired in this pass.
The repository source paths were read only. Written files are confined to the assigned report, ledger and evidence probe directory.
publication_note: Historical research snapshot prepared on 2026-11-12. Repository claims refer to the recorded studied revisions, not current main. Original research used gpt-6-astra with requested ultra reasoning; publication preparation used gpt-6.1-sol.
